method.surface_counts: Each tag counts card records whose current text matches the stored regular-expression definition. Tags overlap.
method.manual_review: Priority clusters were read card by card against 01, 02, 06, 07 and their current canonical text.

deck_bottom_move.pattern: 山札の一番下 or 山札下

discard_to_hand.pattern: 捨て札 ... 手札に戻 within one sentence

derived_groups.note: These are overlapping text signals. Branch-exclusive rewards, opponent growth and paid exchanges are included until manual review separates them.

priority_clusters.name: same-name growth stacking
priority_clusters.finding: Current text has no shared same-name cap for these cards. Legal stacking exists under their individual conditions, but frequency and payoff are unmeasured.
priority_clusters.action: Proxy-test one, two and three-copy hands before adding any cap.

priority_clusters.name: repeatable board growth engines
priority_clusters.finding: Separate once-per-turn or once-per-round engines can reward the same action or victory. This is legal under the current no-global-+10-cap rule.
priority_clusters.action: Measure turns-to-100 and setup cost by engine count.

priority_clusters.name: time-1 replacement-plus-growth
priority_clusters.finding: Thirteen cards can yield both a replacement card or recovery and growth in the same successful route. Their setup costs differ materially.
priority_clusters.action: Record paid time, cards committed, delayed turns and failure outcome separately.

priority_clusters.name: cheap selection density
priority_clusters.finding: Many time-1 routes inspect two to five cards or select a typed card. Conditions differ, but physical search time and deck smoothing can converge.
priority_clusters.action: Measure average cards handled and decision time, not only hand advantage.

priority_clusters.name: discard recovery and replay
priority_clusters.finding: Recovery spans companions, items, worlds, low-stage mains, traps and people. No infinite loop is established, but repeated value depends on surrounding discounts and discard costs.
priority_clusters.action: Track object identity, replay count and net hand/time change in proxy logs.

priority_clusters.name: reservation tracking load
priority_clusters.finding: The pool mixes deadlines, tracked objects, next-event consumption and source-independent applied effects. A surface union finds 107 texts, not 107 simultaneous reservations.
priority_clusters.action: Proxy logs must assign reservation IDs, source IDs, target object IDs and expiry points.

manual_cases.input: Two First Date copies target the same stage-0 partner in one turn
manual_cases.expected: Both are currently legal if time is paid; the first does not advance the relationship. Mark as stacking test, not an automatic text error.

manual_cases.input: Three Midlife Flower copies are played before the next own start
manual_cases.expected: Three separate +5 reservations are created. Do not merge them or impose an unstated same-name cap.

manual_cases.input: Two prepared Curling copies see one completed draw
manual_cases.expected: Each copy may activate under current text; verify preparation cost and total reward in proxy play.

manual_cases.input: Two prepared Domino copies activate from one face-up item
manual_cases.expected: Each can create its own next-play reservation. Resolve and log each reservation separately.

manual_cases.input: Two Takoyaki copies target one third prepared card
manual_cases.expected: Both can later succeed if the tracked object remains. New copies do not satisfy the old target identity.

manual_cases.input: Countryside and Mini Golf share a turn with exactly one action
manual_cases.expected: Mini Golf can give +5 and draw; Countryside can separately give +5. The legal +10 total is not capped.

manual_cases.input: Otter and Jungle are active before one face-up play and one own victory
manual_cases.expected: Normal victory +5, Otter +5 and Jungle +5 can coexist if all conditions hold.

manual_cases.input: Lantern is attached during a turn with another growth reward
manual_cases.expected: Lantern may add its own end-step +5 once. Rare same-one construction remains unchanged.

manual_cases.input: Count all current texts containing deck wording
manual_cases.expected: 183 records. This is a lexical count, not 183 deck operations per game.

manual_cases.input: Count top-look or top-reveal wording
manual_cases.expected: 94 records under the frozen regular expression.

manual_cases.input: Count deck-bottom movement wording
manual_cases.expected: 145 records; bottom placement is the dominant cleanup vocabulary and a physical-load target.

manual_cases.input: Compare direct draw and selective hand-add tags
manual_cases.expected: 108 direct-draw and 56 selective-add records; overlaps remain and must not be summed as unique cards.

manual_cases.input: City Run succeeds after two prior face-up actions
manual_cases.expected: It may add up to two different card types for time1, but its prior-action setup is part of the efficiency cost.

manual_cases.input: Night Light is used from a hand of two including itself
manual_cases.expected: After paying the card, inspect three and add at most one; classify as selection, not a free two-card gain.

manual_cases.input: Hit & Blow guesses correctly versus incorrectly
manual_cases.expected: Correct route adds the revealed card and +5; incorrect route bottoms it and draws one. The branches are not simultaneous.

manual_cases.input: Lucky Coin reveals a main versus a non-main
manual_cases.expected: Growth and draw are mutually exclusive branches, so its surface membership in both groups does not mean both rewards.

manual_cases.input: Count explicit next-own-start wording
manual_cases.expected: 22 records; some expire at that start while others execute at that start.

manual_cases.input: Count explicit next-own-end wording
manual_cases.expected: 6 records, all in main texts under the frozen expression.

manual_cases.input: Count end-timing wording
manual_cases.expected: 51 records; triggered abilities and already-applied delayed effects are mixed.

manual_cases.input: Count the word 次に as a next-event signal
manual_cases.expected: 50 records; not every hit creates a persistent reservation.

manual_cases.input: Union the four reservation-like surface groups
manual_cases.expected: 107 unique records. Do not sum their individual totals.

manual_cases.input: Penguin 7 protection and God 8 replacement coexist on one companion
manual_cases.expected: The affected player chooses applicable replacement/prevention order under 07; each applied effect keeps its own expiry and use count.

manual_cases.input: A tracked prepared card leaves and the same paper is replayed
manual_cases.expected: It is a new object and does not satisfy Harvest, Snowman Tower, Takoyaki or Breakout tracking.

manual_cases.input: A next-start reward is created during R10 without another own start
manual_cases.expected: No new turn is created and the unexecuted reward is not converted into score.

manual_cases.input: Count time-1 action cards with direct draw, selective add or discard recovery wording
manual_cases.expected: 40 records across play 32, item 2 and event 6; paid exchanges and conditional misses are included.

manual_cases.input: Count time-1 action cards with growth wording
manual_cases.expected: 24 records across play 20, item 1 and event 3; opponent growth is included in the surface count.

manual_cases.input: Count time-1 action cards in both surface groups
manual_cases.expected: 16 records; manual review narrows simultaneous own replacement-or-recovery plus growth to 13 priority cards.

manual_cases.input: Dot Eater resolves
manual_cases.expected: The player draws two after spending the card while the opponent gains +5. Treat the opponent reward as a real efficiency cost.

manual_cases.input: Bubble Shooter resolves after bottoming three same-type cards
manual_cases.expected: Three draws and +5 do not mean net +3 cards; include the played card and three-card payment in hand accounting.

manual_cases.input: Jump Quest resolves after two time skips
manual_cases.expected: The recovered low-stage main replaces the played card in hand and +5 is gained; the two skips are setup, not free.

manual_cases.input: Multiple time discounts reduce one legal payment below zero
manual_cases.expected: Apply all legal reductions, floor at zero, consume their reservations and gain no time from overflow.

manual_cases.input: A recovered card is replayed and recovered again later
manual_cases.expected: Log each new object, paid time, recovery source and cycle count; no infinite loop is asserted without a complete legal route.

conclusions: No card text changes are justified by surface density alone.
Deck-bottom handling and reservation tracking are the largest physical-play burdens to measure.
Same-name stacking and time-1 replacement-plus-growth routes are the first balance proxy strata.
The next artifact should preserve version, deck order, choices, payments, chains, reservations and object IDs.
